proposed_capability: P141 selected purposeful Sim traversal as the smallest cross-system VOI intervention: retain the existing verified household navigation graph and independent camera traverse; prevent host-generated Walk spam by enforcing one movement until separately observed goal-domain follow-through. P01 installs a reviewable harness; fifth gear executes bounded read-only product policy and host-plan composition.
player_save_control_impact: No game input or save/OS/EA file writes. Use only explicit current actor/goal/queue movement evidence, preserve player-directed queue, default to passive capture and direct gameplay interaction; do not move the Sim to scan or claim camera movement is physical progress.
expected_outcome: One host-generated walk maximum before reviewed needs/career/skills/whims objective action; durable checkpoint prevents repeated walk after queue drains; camera view changes use independent map lease and do not consume a Sim movement slot; unknown/stale observations abstain. Host plan exports action-bound VOI advice only.
negative_tests: Two host walks in a queue abstain
One pending walk blocks a second walk
Completed walk without observed goal action blocks repeat
Camera pan never counts as a walk or progress
Direct game-native object interaction preferred to walk
No host-plan return grants game input
rollback_path: Revert feature PR; new advisory branch has no persistent model, screen effects or saved-game migration. Existing household_navigation and camera_traverse remain owners.
unresolved_unknowns: Exact game build and local Sims 4 Live Mode unavailable in GitHub provider
Host adapters enforcing an actual queued walk have not been physically certified
ML VOI calibration requires real consented labeled outcomes; heuristic selection is advisory only
decision_rationale: P141 alternatives: expanding sparse SLAM/EA parsing is already owned and does not fix action spam (DEFERRED); making queue capacity smaller cannot bind movement to terminal domain value (REJECTED); action-bound VOI and one-walk checkpoint on the existing route owner directly addresses repeated regression with small reversible tests (SURVIVES, selected). P01 limited to harness; fifth gear owns product behavior.
